attempts.bug_summary: Path variables are merged after the explicitly supplied model, so a path variable with the same name overrides the caller's model attribute. This only changes behavior when both sources provide the same key.

When a view name contains named fragment parameters, the method installs the merged model as the expression context variables instead of installing the parameters extracted from the fragment expression. As a result, fragment parameter values are not available under their declared names during template processing, particularly when they differ from or are absent in the regular model.
